# Neonix Infra Solutions

> Neonix Infra Solutions is a premier certified rooftop solar EPC contractor in India specializing in residential, commercial, and industrial solar installations under the PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana government subsidy scheme.

Neonix provides end-to-end clean energy solutions including MNRE-approved Tier-1 solar panel installation, DISCOM net metering facilitation (JVVNL, AVVNL, JdVVNL, and pan-India state DISCOMs), zero-down solar financing options, and 30-year Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC) to help homes and businesses reduce electricity bills by up to 90%.

## PM Surya Ghar Muft Bijli Yojana Subsidy Breakdown
- **1 kW System**: ₹30,000 Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy
- **2 kW System**: ₹60,000 Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) subsidy
- **3 kW to 10 kW System**: ₹78,000 Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT) maximum residential subsidy
- **Commercial / Industrial**: Accelerated Depreciation (AD) tax benefits and customized CAPEX / OPEX models

## Hardware & Engineering Specifications
- **Solar Modules**: Tier-1 ALMM & DCR compliant Mono PERC and TopCon Bifacial solar panels (25 to 30-year performance warranty)
- **Inverters**: High-efficiency grid-tied smart string inverters with Wi-Fi IoT real-time generation tracking
- **Mounting Structures**: Hot-dip galvanized steel engineered to withstand wind speeds up to 150 km/h

## Main Services & Interactive Tools
- [Rooftop Solar Solutions](https://www.neonixinfra.in/): Comprehensive overview of grid-tied, hybrid, and off-grid rooftop solar plants for residential, commercial, and industrial properties.
- [Solar ROI & Savings Calculator](https://www.neonixinfra.in/#roi-calculator): Interactive tool to calculate monthly electricity bill savings, payback period, net savings over 25 years, and PM Surya Ghar subsidy amounts.
- [PM Surya Ghar Subsidy Guide](https://www.neonixinfra.in/#subsidy-info): Official subsidy guidelines, eligibility rules, and 4-step subsidy application process.
- [Rooftop Feasibility Diagnostic](https://www.neonixinfra.in/#feasibility-checker): 3-step diagnostic questionnaire evaluating rooftop area, shadow-free space, connection sanction load, and recommended kW capacity.
- [Trust Signals & Certifications](https://www.neonixinfra.in/#certifications): Tier-1 ALMM accreditation, MNRE channel partnership details, and ISO/BIS standards.
